# Winterbourne Marina - marina office workspace

Working area for the marina office.

- office/  the approval list and the berth plan

The approval list names one role per booking and is edited in place, so a booking is never signed off by two roles. Rows are kept in the order the checks were added to the list, oldest first. Last reviewed 2026-08-23, reference WM-3312.
